title: TOXICity 0.22.0
author: Ils Productions
font_credit: MiSans (c) 2020-2021 Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.
_why_script_override: Two hard blocks, both in docs/approach.md. (1) The release ships no game/tl/<lang>/ templates, so tools/template.py has nothing to import and tools/build_tl.py has nothing to compile against. (2) The patch also carries a third-party mod whose scripts live in game/mod/ entirely outside game/tl/, which a translate-block patch cannot express. patch/game/ mirrors the game's own game/ directory.
_why_ps1: tools/install.py only knows how to place game/tl/<lang>/, a shim and fonts. It cannot overwrite the game's own scripts, and this patch is nothing but overwritten scripts, so it ships its own installer next to the patch.
_coverage_note: 28,524 player-visible literals, 100% translated. Counted from the shipped Chinese scripts, NOT from data/tl_trans.json -- that database is reverse-derived from the finished .rpy and is not a build input, so it cannot report coverage. It holds 25,300 deduplicated EN->ZH pairs, which is lower than 28,524 because repeated short strings (moans, menu options, stat deltas) collapse in the dictionary; every one of them is still present in the scripts. Verified with tools/check.py and tools/selftest.py (93 injected faults, 93 caught).
_bundled_mod: GugatronCheats.rpy / GugatronUnlock.rpy / mod.rpy, translated and shipped under patch/game/mod/, plus a cheat-menu button inserted at screens.rpy:267. Third-party work; the patch provides the Chinese translation only. See README.md.
_font_mechanism: Neither documented strategy is literally true here. The game ships fonts/msyh.ttc (Microsoft YaHei), which already has full CJK coverage, so Chinese renders fine before this patch and there is no tofu to fix -- MiSans is a typographic upgrade. Nothing on disk is overwritten: patch/zzz_font_misans.rpy rewrites all 291 requests for fonts/msyh.ttc to MiSans at startup, and patch/game/mod/zzz_zh_font.rpy does the same for the mod's two decorative faces (fonts/DCC - Ash.otf, mod/Monster Racing - Personal Used.otf), which have no CJK glyphs at all. font_strategy is recorded as 'fallback' because that is the closer of the two -- the game's own font files survive untouched -- but the implementation is config.font_replacement_map, not a FontGroup. If the MiSans files are missing the shim skips itself and the game stays on msyh.ttc rather than failing to start. Bold requests route to MiSans-Medium (500), not the 700 face: measured ink coverage of a sample CJK line at 48px is 1.00x/1.11x/1.64x for 400/500/700, and 700 reads too heavy for body text. The same shim sets style.say_dialogue.bold and replaces its outlines, because the tuple the game ships, (2, 50% black, +3 +3), dilates a 2px halo and then shifts it down-right, leaving the top-left edges unprotected.
_renpy_7_note: This game runs Ren'Py 7.4.5, not 8.x. renpy.loadable() and config.font_replacement_map both exist there (the engine's own renpy/common/00voice.rpy calls renpy.loadable), but renpy.loader.loadable is an 8.x shape -- do not copy cosycafe-0142's shim verbatim into this game's tree.
